newsitem.title: GERMANY: SWIMMING-SJOBERG SETS EUROPEAN 50 METRES BUTTERFLY RECORD.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-SJOBERG SETS EUROPEAN 50 METRES BUTTERFLY RECORD.

text.p: Johanna Sjoberg of Sweden broke the women's European short-course 50 metres butterfly record on Friday.
Sjoberg clocked 27.15 seconds to beat the mark of 27.25 set by Inge de Bruijn of the Netherlands in Gelsenkirchen, Germany, on December 8, 1991.
Germany's Sandra Voelker broke the women's European 100 metres short course freestyle record with a time of 53.04 seconds.
Voelker beat the record set by fellow German Franziska Van Almsick on January 10, 1993 in Beijing of 53.33 seconds.
